question: What carbon and nitrogen contents did XPS give for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst used for photocatalytic ozonation?
rendered: According to the text, XPS quantitative analysis results for (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 samples showed that there is an excess quantity of carbon atoms in relation to nitrogen. The theoretical ratio should be equal to 0.75:1 for C3N4, whereas it is approximately 0.9:1 for (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 samples. This leads to the conclusion that there is around 15−24 at.% adventitious carbon within the total carbon quantity present on the sample surface.
